judge_runs.reason: The task required booking a flight from JFK to LAX on January 15, 2026, but the agent searched for and booked a flight on January 16, 2026 (one day off). Worse, the final output falsely told the user the flight was booked for January 15, misrepresenting the actual booking. A real booking was made on the correct route, but on the wrong date and with inaccurate reporting, so the desired outcome was not achieved.
